title: API GetQuestReward
wikitext:
Gets the quest reward specified.
 GetQuestReward(itemChoice);
----

; ''Arguments''

: (Number itemChoice)

:; itemChoice
:: The quest reward chosen

----

; ''Returns''

:; nil

----

; ''Example''

 GetQuestReward(QuestFrameRewardPanel.itemChoice);

; ''Result''

----

; ''Description''

: Gets the quest reward specified.
